subject: english
question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The erroneous spelling is **"Precission"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct spelling is **"precision"**
 
• The meaning of the word is "the quality, condition, or fact of being exact and accurate"
 
• Let's see an example-
 
 
• Great precision is required to align the mirrors accurately.
 
 
 
• **Omission** - a person or thing that has been left out or excluded.
 
• **Remission** - the cancellation of a debt, charge, or penalty.
 
• **Recession** - a period of temporary economic decline during which trade and industrial activity are reduced.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 4.**
